verdict.rationale: Mailgun is API-first: it offers APIs and multi-language SDKs for sending, receiving and tracking email, so it runs headlessly by nature. It also documents a first-party GitHub Actions integration for sending email from CI workflows, plus scoped Domain Sending Keys suited to automated pipelines. Missing for 10: an official CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and deeper CI setup documentation such as secrets handling and non-interactive domain provisioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Send automated emails directly from your GitHub workflows. Notify teams about pushes, pull requests, deployments, and more without leaving your repository.
Powerful APIs that enable you to send, receive, and track email effortlessly
Our SDKs support multiple programming languages, allowing you to seamlessly send, receive, and track emails within your applications.
Domain Sending Keys are API keys that only allow sending messages via a POST call on /messages and /messages.mime endpoints for the domain in which they are created for.
